messages:
maria: Heads-up: nightly reconcile surfaced ~48 invoices where discounts were applied in Stripe but not reflected in NetSuite. Suspect webhook mapping for `invoice.discount` is dropping when discount metadata is present.
leo_fin: How big is the dollar impact? Need to know whether to open a manual adjustment batch.
maria: Preliminary sum ~2,760. Stripe payloads show discount lines under `lines.data[].discounts` but our parser expects top-level `discount` object. Example payload snippet I grabbed:

```
"lines": { "data": [{ "id": "il_1", "amount": 12000, "discounts": [{ "coupon": "PX50" }] }] }
```
Our NetSuite mapping looked for `invoice.discount` and then created credit memos only when present.
sam: That mismatch happened after we onboarded dynamic coupon bundles last month. Parser change must have lost `discounts` array handling. I'll patch consumer to normalize `lines[].discounts` -> `invoice.applied_discounts` and emit metric `webhook.discount.unhandled` for unseen shapes.
ops-bot: Scheduled job daily-recon ran at 2026-03-22T05:00:12Z. 48 mismatches flagged. See /jobs/5678
leo_fin: Finance: authorize auto-backfill if total < $5k and individual delta < $1k. This run qualifies. Please include audit note linking Stripe event ids.
maria: Will prepare CSV and dry-run. Dry-run command:

```
./bin/backfill --source=stripe --file=/secure-drive/finance/discounts_2210002222.csv --dry-run
```
sam: PR: https://internal/git/stripe-consumer/pull/510 - summary: normalize discount shapes, add unit tests, instrument metric. Plan to canary in staging then 10% prod.
billing-bot: Dry-run completed: 48 records, total credit $2,760.34. Output /tmp/dryrun_2210002222.json
maria: Starting backfill (rate 8/s) after finance approval.
leo_fin: Approved. Ensure memos reference coupon codes and event ids.
ops-bot: Backfill job started job_id=77654. ETA 15m.
sam: Deployed normalization to staging. Observed metric `webhook.discount.unhandled` drop to zero in staging after patch. Canary scheduled.
maria: Backfill finished. NetSuite credit memos created: 48. CSV of journals uploaded to /secure-drive/finance/discount_memos_2210002222.csv
leo_fin: Thanks — closing for now. Please add a small alert to track newly seen discount shapes in future.
sam: Will add alert `discount.shape.unknown > 0` to paging rules."
